strengths: Fresh experiments dated May-September 2025, after Nyby 2020 and Soccol 2024 releases.
Commercial Fe-based stainless steel; measured pH and chloride vary.
Same intended pitting-potential outcome; raw scans and processed data public; specified Ag/AgCl 1 M KCl reference.
limitations: One material; paper calls it 304 and specifies UNS S30403. Exact measured heat composition not located.
56 campaign measurements are paired replicates of 28 prepared environments (27 distinct nominal combinations); extra 32 validation replicates do not add environmental diversity.
Britton-Robinson buffer contains phosphate/borate/acetate; authors report roughly 400 mV higher potentials than conventional mapping studies and changed pH dependence.
Supplement section S2 reports 8 problematic automatic labels: noise, secondary current rises, or unclear stable pitting.
Supplement names 20250922_004_6 and _7 as noise failures, but repository last condition is cells 7 and 8: resolve ID discrepancy before exclusion.
data_old.csv values differ from final supplementary plot annotations. Do not assume this table is final corrected ground truth.
Audit no-pitting/censoring, electrode drift and SCE conversion before finalization.
